title: Adjust Apple Pay button corners when useful

statement.en: You may adjust the Apple Pay button's corner radius to match other buttons.
statement.ja: 他のボタンの外観に合わせて、Apple Payボタンの角丸の半径を調整してよい。

conditions: Buttons are rounded by default; square or capsule shapes are available alternatives.
